transcript.text: Hello everyone. I've been asked to restore a worn 1920s community cookbook. It has a detached cover and several loose pages, so it's clearly seen a lot of use over the years. Before I can accept any restoration work, though, I need to follow my workshop rule: no restoration is accepted until the condition, schedule, and materials are all written up on the job card. So let's get the details sorted — what do I need to know about this project?
